row.notes: Per-frame render-frame-graph (RFG) build step. If pass list +0x90..+0x98 is empty it only ages the 12 transient resource pools +0x2b0..+0x308 (FUN_143bdb150(pool,3,0); the +0x308 cache is walked inline and entries idle >=3 frames go to Gfx2Device deferred release). Otherwise sorts the queue objects by type (*q+0x20: 0,1,2) into a 4-slot array, runs the compiler FUN_143bd6ac0(rfg+0x160, flags{1,1,1,0}, rfg+0xe8), calls vtbl+0x20 on every pool, then for each access (+0x70, elem 0x28) creates/reuses a view by kind (view elem 0x160 at +0x50: 0=FUN_1439d9760, 1=CreateTrackedObject, 2=NewDeferredCommand, 3=CreateResourceObject) via an FNV-1a keyed cache, and finally replays the command list +0xf0 (type,index pairs) into the queues (FUN_143b5af50 for passes, marker push for type 2). Resource elem is 0x180 at +0x30; good hook to observe the compiled pass order.
